preconditions: Prepared selection app with suggested locale
expected: Disabled case resolves and deploys only app/runtime; enabled case includes locale, with exact prepared commits.

behaviors.description: Public custom-path dependency installation avoids runtime duplication.
preconditions: Isolated source with installed runtime and two empty targets
expected: Registered source omits target runtime operation and deployment; unregistered control installs runtime; source remains unchanged.

behaviors.description: Automatic SDK and debug deployments with independent flag controls.
preconditions: Distinct SDK and app/runtime/SDK debug refs
expected: All flag combinations deploy exact expected refs; update adds SDK/debug; uninstall-only adds no installs; getters reflect flags.

behaviors.description: Disabling dependencies excludes absent runtime from resolved operations.
expected: Only app resolves with flag enabled; default transaction installs both refs.

behaviors.description: Explicit runtime automatic pinning and suppression.
expected: Normal runtime install pins; fresh unpinned runtime with disable-auto-pin stays unpinned.

mappings.rationale: Set disable_related both TRUE and FALSE on independent transactions. Exact operation and installed-ref sets exclude/include suggested locale while retaining required runtime; verify prepared commits.

Public new_for_path creates isolated user source and targets. Native add_dependency_source with installed runtime removes runtime from resolved operations and target enumeration; omission control installs second runtime. Source enumeration and exact commit remain unchanged.
Independent SDK/debug flags and getters, exact prepared app/runtime/SDK/debug deployment sets, update control, and uninstall-only operation types and remaining refs.
Exact one-app resolved list excludes missing runtime with flag enabled, compared with default dependency install.
Public pinned-ref enumeration includes normally explicitly installed runtime; remove pin via setup CLI, reinstall with suppression and require empty public pinned list.
